template.notes: One RSI teacher block is translated: an oversold reading (RsiSellLevel 30) on a recent bar turning higher while the fast MA (FirstMaPeriod 10) rises. Every period and level is a fallback since none are documented, and the separate hourly MA/RSI filter, second teacher, ATR stop/target factors, pip trailing, pyramiding, LockCoefficient, session hours and Friday switch are not expressible.
